title: TyG-WHtR index and all-cause mortality among adults in a population cohort
abstract: The TyG-WHtR index was independently associated with all-cause mortality in adults, even after adjusting for conventional risk factors.
journal: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism Research
evidence_sentence: The TyG-WHtR index was independently associated with all-cause mortality in adults, even after adjusting for conventional risk factors.
evidence_sentence_zh: TyG-WHtR 指数与成人全因死亡独立相关，即使在调整常规危险因素后仍显著。

title: Non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio in NHANES and UK Biobank
abstract: NHHR was evaluated as a derived lipid indicator in population cohorts and showed incremental association with cardiometabolic outcomes.
display_name_zh_guess: 非高密度脂蛋白/高密度脂蛋白比值
evidence_sentence: NHHR was evaluated as a derived lipid indicator in population cohorts and showed incremental association with cardiometabolic outcomes.
evidence_sentence_zh: NHHR 被作为人群队列中的脂质派生指标评估，并与心血管代谢结局存在增量关联。

title: RAR and prognosis in critically ill patients from MIMIC and eICU
abstract: RAR was associated with mortality among critically ill adults, but abbreviation expansion differed across included reports.
display_name_zh_guess: 红细胞分布宽度/白蛋白比值
evidence_sentence: RAR was associated with mortality among critically ill adults, but abbreviation expansion differed across included reports.
evidence_sentence_zh: RAR 与重症成人死亡风险相关，但不同报告中的缩写展开并不完全一致。
ambiguity_notes: RAR 可能指 RDW-to-albumin ratio，也可能指 retinoic acid receptor。

title: Fatty liver index predicts metabolic outcomes in UK Biobank participants
abstract: The fatty liver index was used as a non-invasive risk score and was associated with incident metabolic disease in UK Biobank.
evidence_sentence: The fatty liver index was used as a non-invasive risk score and was associated with incident metabolic disease in UK Biobank.
evidence_sentence_zh: 脂肪肝指数作为非侵入性风险评分，在 UK Biobank 中与新发代谢性疾病相关。

title: CAR as an inflammatory marker across NHANES and ICU cohorts
abstract: CAR was reported as an inflammatory ratio in cohort analyses, but the title did not expand the abbreviation.
display_name_zh_guess: C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比值
evidence_sentence: CAR was reported as an inflammatory ratio in cohort analyses, but the title did not expand the abbreviation.
evidence_sentence_zh: CAR 被作为炎症比值用于队列分析，但标题未展开该缩写。
ambiguity_notes: CAR 可能指 C-reactive protein/albumin ratio，也可能指 chimeric antigen receptor。
